# Packages and paths

```{r packages}
library(DESeq2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(here)
library(pheatmap)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
```

```{r paths}
deseq_dir <- here("results", "deseq2")
annotation_dir <- here("results", "annotations")
figure_dir <- here("results", "figures")
dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

dds_file <- here(deseq_dir, "dds.rds")
vst_file <- here(deseq_dir, "vst_data.rds")
stopifnot(file.exists(dds_file), file.exists(vst_file))

dds <- readRDS(dds_file)
vst_data <- readRDS(vst_file)

treatment_colours <- c(CC = "#65b3c1", CV = "#f09e3a", VV = "#e36348")
```

# DEG summary

```{r deg-summary, fig.width=9, fig.height=5}
summary_file <- here(deseq_dir, "differential_expression_summary.csv")
deg_summary <- read_csv(summary_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

contrast_labels <- c(
  CV_vs_CC = "Acute response to low pH",
  VV_vs_CC = "Chronic exposure to low pH",
  VV_vs_CV = "Genotype-of-origin"
)

deg_plot_data <- deg_summary |>
  transmute(
    contrast = recode(contrast, !!!contrast_labels),
    Up = up_lfc1,
    Down = down_lfc1
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(c(Up, Down), names_to = "regulation", values_to = "count") |>
  group_by(contrast) |>
  mutate(
    percent = round(100 * count / sum(count)),
    label = paste0(percent, "%\n", count)
  ) |>
  ungroup()

p_deg <- ggplot(
  deg_plot_data,
  aes(x = contrast, y = count, fill = regulation)
) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = label),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.7),
    vjust = -0.4,
    size = 4
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(Up = "#F2B44E", Down = "#BA90CB"),
    labels = c(Up = "Up-regulated", Down = "Down-regulated")
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Differentially expressed genes", fill = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

p_deg
ggsave(file.path(figure_dir, "deg_counts.pdf"), p_deg, width = 9, height = 5)
```

# Volcano plots

```{r volcano-functions}
contrast_files <- c(
  VV_vs_CC = "deseq2_VV_vs_CC.csv",
  CV_vs_CC = "deseq2_CV_vs_CC.csv",
  VV_vs_CV = "deseq2_VV_vs_CV.csv"
)

make_volcano <- function(result_table, title) {
  plot_data <- result_table |>
    mutate(
      significance = case_when(
        !is.na(padj) & padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange > 1 ~ "Up",
        !is.na(padj) & padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange < -1 ~ "Down",
        TRUE ~ "Not significant"
      ),
      minus_log10_padj = -log10(pmax(padj, .Machine$double.xmin))
    )

  ggplot(plot_data, aes(log2FoldChange, minus_log10_padj, colour = significance)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.2, na.rm = TRUE) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed") +
    scale_colour_manual(
      values = c(
        Down = "#65b3c1",
        `Not significant` = "grey75",
        Up = "#e36348"
      )
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = expression(log[2]~fold~change),
      y = expression(-log[10]~adjusted~italic(P)),
      colour = NULL
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
    theme(legend.position = "top")
}
```

```{r volcano-plots, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
for (contrast_name in names(contrast_files)) {
  result_table <- read_csv(
    file.path(deseq_dir, contrast_files[[contrast_name]]),
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )
  p <- make_volcano(result_table, gsub("_", " ", contrast_name))
  print(p)
  ggsave(
    file.path(figure_dir, paste0("volcano_", contrast_name, ".pdf")),
    p,
    width = 7,
    height = 5
  )
}
```

# Heatmaps of significant genes

```{r heatmap-functions}
make_deg_heatmap <- function(contrast_name, groups) {
  result_table <- read_csv(
    file.path(deseq_dir, contrast_files[[contrast_name]]),
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )

  deg_genes <- result_table |>
    filter(!is.na(padj), padj < 0.05) |>
    pull(gene_id) |>
    intersect(rownames(vst_data))

  if (length(deg_genes) == 0) {
    warning("No significant genes for ", contrast_name)
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  keep_samples <- colData(vst_data)$treatment %in% groups
  matrix_data <- assay(vst_data)[deg_genes, keep_samples, drop = FALSE]
  matrix_data <- matrix_data - rowMeans(matrix_data)

  annotation_col <- data.frame(
    treatment = droplevels(colData(vst_data)$treatment[keep_samples])
  )
  rownames(annotation_col) <- colnames(matrix_data)

  pheatmap(
    matrix_data,
    show_rownames = FALSE,
    show_colnames = FALSE,
    annotation_col = annotation_col,
    annotation_colors = list(
      treatment = treatment_colours[groups]
    ),
    cluster_cols = FALSE,
    border_color = NA,
    filename = file.path(figure_dir, paste0("heatmap_", contrast_name, ".pdf")),
    width = 7,
    height = 7
  )
}
```

```{r heatmaps}
make_deg_heatmap("VV_vs_CC", c("CC", "VV"))
make_deg_heatmap("CV_vs_CC", c("CC", "CV"))
make_deg_heatmap("VV_vs_CV", c("CV", "VV"))
```

# Biomineralization-gene expression

This section runs after `03_biomineralization_genes.Rmd`. It plots
mean VST expression for the curated candidate genes that are present in the
count matrix.

```{r biomineralization-heatmap, fig.width=7, fig.height=10}
biomineralization_file <- here(
  annotation_dir,
  "biomineralization_candidates.csv"
)

if (file.exists(biomineralization_file)) {
  candidates <- read_csv(
    biomineralization_file,
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )

  candidate_genes <- intersect(candidates$gene_id, rownames(vst_data))
  mean_expression <- sapply(levels(colData(vst_data)$treatment), function(group) {
    rowMeans(
      assay(vst_data)[
        candidate_genes,
        colData(vst_data)$treatment == group,
        drop = FALSE
      ]
    )
  })

  candidate_annotation <- candidates |>
    filter(gene_id %in% candidate_genes) |>
    distinct(gene_id, Function_class) |>
    as.data.frame()
  rownames(candidate_annotation) <- candidate_annotation$gene_id
  candidate_annotation$gene_id <- NULL
  candidate_annotation <- candidate_annotation[rownames(mean_expression), , drop = FALSE]

  pheatmap(
    mean_expression,
    scale = "row",
    show_rownames = FALSE,
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    cluster_cols = FALSE,
    annotation_row = candidate_annotation,
    border_color = NA,
    main = "Biomineralization-gene expression",
    filename = file.path(figure_dir, "biomineralization_mean_vst.pdf"),
    width = 7,
    height = 10
  )
} else {
  message(
    "Biomineralization annotations not found. Run analysis/",
    "03_biomineralization_genes.Rmd first."
  )
}
```
